sermon.title: Abandoning False Prophets
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In this second session on present truth, Pastor David G. Kincer reviews the seasons of the last days: false prophets and antichrists, persecution, the falling away, restoration, the gospel to all nations and increased knowledge, and warns against date-setting. He then gives eight Bible marks for recognizing and abandoning false prophets, above all that they strengthen evildoers and tell people sin is okay, and says the love that waxes cold is love for God shown by obeying him.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: This is presented as the second session on “present truth.” At 2:20 he cites “Matthew 23 11” for many false prophets; the verse that says this is Matthew 24:11, which is linked. At 3:14 and 8:17 he cites “Luke 21 11” for persecution and for wars and earthquakes; the persecution verses are Luke 21:12-17. At 12:17 he says “John 4 1-3” for the passage in First John 4:1-3. The children of Issachar are in 1 Chronicles 12:32 (he cites 12:21-38). Historical dates and figures (e.g. 476 to 1500 A.D., the printing press in 1440, the revival years) and the list of church bodies at 21:01 are given as spoken and have not been checked.

faqs.question: Could Christ have returned before the 1500s?
faqs.answer: He says no, because all nations were not discovered until the 1500s, so the scriptures about all nations would not have been fulfilled, though people predicted his return for hundreds of years.

faqs.question: How dark was the falling away?
faqs.answer: He says the church in the dark ages was gross and corrupt, Christianity had almost been snuffed out, and you have to dig deep to find little pockets of faithful Christians.

faqs.question: Why hasn’t Christ come yet?
faqs.answer: He says Jesus must remain in heaven until the restoration of all things, and he has not restored all things yet, so he cannot come.

scriptures.text_nkjv: whom heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, which God has spoken by the mouth of all His holy prophets since the world began.

faqs.question: What faith do false prophets try to turn you from?
faqs.answer: He says it is the faith that God has power to perform what he promised: to forgive, deliver and mature you by his power, and to finish the good work he began in you.

faqs.question: What do false prophets tell people about sin?
faqs.answer: He says they tell people no evil shall happen to them, God is love, they have eternal security because they believe in Jesus and can do what they want, and God wants them to be happy.

faqs.question: Why do false teachers teach that sin is okay?
faqs.answer: He says they want your tithes, offerings and money, Americans are gullible and buy the books, and they live in mansions and drive fancy cars.

faqs.question: How do you know a false prophet by their fruits?
faqs.answer: He says a good tree cannot bear bad fruit, so you know them by their behavior and by the behavior of those they prophesy to; it is in the actions.

scriptures.text_nkjv: You will know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes from thornbushes or figs from thistles? Even so, every good tree bears good fruit, but a bad tree bears bad fruit. A good tree cannot bear bad fruit, nor can a bad tree bear good fruit.

faqs.question: Why do some ministers preach what people want to hear?
faqs.answer: He says people will idolize your name, lift up your position and pay you well, and many ministers do not want to lose anybody, especially a big donor.

faqs.question: Can compassion or “God is love” replace obeying God?
faqs.answer: He says portions to the poor, medical care for the miserable, sentiment for sinners, “God is love” and eternal security do not replace the first commandment to love God by obeying him.
